content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed railway operations service (line/station design + train scheduling + incident reporting) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native railway operations primitives open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: MVP proven. Line topology = ordered station list with km-post + dwell, sufficient for single-track linear services. Severity DMN routes major events to gov audit channel.
content.recommendations: Add GTFS-RT-compatible getTrainPositions for realtime ops; introduce graph topology for branching/junctions; extend incidentSeverity DMN with cause taxonomy.
